description: Data no general crypto service has, by view. premium: each stock token's DEX vs Chainlink vs Lighter perp vs Robinhood feed price and gaps, with history for up to 4 tokens. deployer: a token's or pool's deployer and how their other tokens ended. dividends: multiplier steps vs real cash dividends. smart_money: wallets by realised profit on the top tokens and what they bought. listings: new Robinhood stock tokens and Lighter markets. filings: 8-Ks and insider cluster buys where the token or perp has not moved since. unlocks: scheduled token unlocks (DefiLlama), cliff or linear, as a percent of circulating supply, from 3 days back (a short into an unlock holds until a day after) to days ahead; ticker is the coin.
name: rh_signals
title: Robinhood Chain signals
